By Kei FUNANO

Abstract.
In this paper, we study the Le´vy-Milman concentration
phenomenon of 1-Lipschitz maps from mm-spaces to R-trees. Our main theorems
assert that the concentration to R-trees is equivalent to the concentration to the
real line.

joined by a geodesic between them. Let X be a geodesic space. A geodesic triangle
in X is the union of the image of three geodesics joining a triple of points in X
